source.rationale: The unrecognised-envelope guard exists to stop a fail-OPEN dump of EVERY file, so it suppresses only when there is more than one attachment. With exactly one file there is no list to get wrong: the attachment rides through and only the diagnostic key is stamped. This pins the `> 1` boundary that a `>= 1` mutation would silently widen into swallowing single-file answers.
